body.x: DROGEN was honored with ‘Best of MADE IN KOREA at CES 2017 Top10’ held in Las Vegas from Wednesday, January 5 to Friday, August 8.

‘Best of KOREA’ at CES 2017 Top 10’ considered the latest IT trends, growth rate, and possibility, and selected this company among promising Korean companies that showed enough potential within US market in global media Aving News.

The characteristic of this product that DROGEN displayed at the exhibition is that Full HD video shooting is possible as a new product line of 2017 along with Sports Drones and Toy Drones. The new product line, which is made in a small size, is convenient to operate and can fly about 20 minutes once it is charged.

Puzzle X 250 and Puzzle X 230, which will be released in January, are available either with Pikaia1 or User for FC Module, and they are designed with carbon material. Puzzle X 250GT, which will be released in March, is also available either with Pikaia1 or User for FC module. The frame is made of plastic (applied diagrid method), and components and motors can be changed.

The world’s largest IT Consumer Electronics Show, CES, is an exhibition that helps to understand the trend of the global electronic industry at a glimpse, and is held in January every year by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA)

Aving News, which has reported the most recent issues of CES, MWC and IFA, the world’s top three technology exhibitions over the past decade, has also sent a special report team to CES this year, reporting on major issues of the market and introducing Korean companies to the world.
